unsupported: The operation was established by Matt and Jill Teets, who run it alongside their three sons—Justin, JW, and Jordan.

In addition to daily livestock and crop management, the company organizes several annual community events, including the Bulls N’ Barrels Rodeo, the Teets/Griswold Mt Classic Production Sale, and the Teets/Griswold Pounds to Profit Bull Sale, which attract buyers and spectators from across the region.
Teets Cattle Company primarily serves individual consumers seeking locally sourced meat and agricultural buyers looking for breeding stock.
Its production sales provide a venue for other cattle producers to acquire genetics, while the direct-to-table offering appeals to households in West Virginia and surrounding areas.
The Teets family emphasizes simplicity and stewardship as their guiding principles.
